decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application for the conversion of the building from flats to a single dwellinghouse, demolition of existing rear extension and fire escape, erection of single storey rear conservatory and alterations to the exterior of the building and boundary fencing, as shown on drawing numbers 545/01F, 545/02D, 545/03D and 545/04F, should be granted Listed Building consent as the proposal is sympathetic to the style and form of the original building, would maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours, and is considered enhance the character and appearance of the Bedford Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - A schedule and details for all new windows, doors and architraves (and any repair works to existing) at a scale of 1:20 shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Full details of the following items shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter:
(a)	structural sections, decorative details and glazing to the conservatory
(b)	details on any new repointing and brickwork repairs
(c)	balustrading

Condition : 6 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
Condition : 7 - A sample roof tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
Condition : 8 - All external joinery shall be of painted timber.

Condition : 9 - The position, type and manner of installation of all new and relocated services and fittings shall be specified in writing in advance of any work being carried out, and the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority must be obtained wherever these installations are to be visible or where ducts or other methods of concealment are proposed.
Condition : 10 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on te approved drawings.
Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until there has been photographic survey of the internal features such as fireplaces, skirting etc submitted to the Local Planning Authority.
description: Conversion from flats to single dwellinghouse, demolition of rear extension, external and internal alterations, erection of conservatory to rear and erection of new boundary fencing (Listed Building application)
